summary: Completed independent READ-ONLY verification of Checkpoint 2 closeout - Referrer-Policy fix (commit b721fe4). Tested at mobile (390x844) and desktop (1440x900) viewports against preview URL. Verified that `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer` response header successfully prevents attribution query parameters from leaking in browser Referer headers. All 10 test requirements passed with ZERO violations detected.
passed_tests: Requirement 1: HTML page responses for /, /ottawa, /toronto, /hamilton, /tire-match all carry response header `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`

Requirement 2: Attribution captured correctly in localStorage key `t4t.attribution.v1` with all 9 synthetic parameters (source=tsrc-x9, campaign=tcamp-x9, shop=tshop-x9, package=tpkg-x9, price=tprice-x9, utm_source=tutm-src-x9, utm_medium=tutm-med-x9, utm_campaign=tutm-cmp-x9, city=ottawa) and landing_url containing /ottawa
Requirement 3: Original attribution record unchanged after city selector navigation (Ottawa -> Toronto), /tire-match load without parameters, and page reload

Requirement 4: Wizard flow completed successfully - city preselected from URL (?city=ottawa), postal code K8Y 8Y8 entered, travel radius 25km selected, repair option chosen, issue description 'Synthetic note teal-otter-77' entered, next-step-notice displayed
Requirement 5a: Network inspection - 117 requests captured per viewport with wire-level headers via CDP Network.requestWillBeSentExtraInfo (72 wire-level headers captured)

Requirement 5b: Application requests (36 per viewport) - ZERO Referer headers sent to page loads (/ottawa, /toronto, /tire-match, /), static assets (/static/js/*), or API endpoints (/api/public/config, /api/public/locations)
Requirement 5c: Development overlay requests (19 per viewport) - ZERO Referer headers sent to /__emergent_overlay__/report or /__emergent_overlay__/health
Requirement 5d: Preview host requests (14 per viewport) - ZERO Referer headers sent to /cdn-cgi/* or static.cloudflareinsights.com

Requirement 5e: Google Fonts requests (48 per viewport) - 36 requests sent Referer header, but ONLY 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/' (fonts.googleapis.com -> fonts.gstatic.com), containing ZERO attribution values

Requirement 5f: ZERO requests across all categories (application, overlay, preview host, fonts) contained ANY synthetic attribution values (tsrc-x9, tcamp-x9, tshop-x9, tpkg-x9, tprice-x9, tutm-src-x9, tutm-med-x9, tutm-cmp-x9, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign) in Referer headers
Requirement 6: Typed wizard values ('K8Y 8Y8', 'K8Y%208Y8', 'K8Y+8Y8', 'teal-otter-77') appeared in ZERO request URLs, bodies, or headers to any host
Requirement 7a: Session recorder OFF - 'rrweb' in window is false
Requirement 7b: Session recorder OFF - ZERO <script> tags with src containing 'recorder' or 'rrweb'
Requirement 7c: Session recorder OFF - ZERO network requests to paths containing 'recorder' or 'rrweb'
Requirement 7d: Overlay ON - '__EMERGENT_OVERLAY__' in window is true
Requirement 8a: GET /api/health returns 200 with status ok, database connected, migration_revision 0002, environment staging
Requirement 8b: GET /__emergent_overlay__/health returns 200 with healthy true
Requirement 8c: Pages /, /ottawa, /toronto, /hamilton, /tire-match all render without console errors or red error screen
Requirement 9a: Application API traffic is GET only - 24 GET requests to /api/public/config and /api/public/locations
Requirement 9b: Application API traffic has ZERO POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE requests
Requirement 9c: Application API requests carry ZERO request bodies
Requirement 10a: Outside repository control - Cloudflare cookies (cf_clearance, __cf_bm) present (set by preview host edge)
Requirement 10b: Outside repository control - Cloudflare beacon script (static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js) loaded (injected by preview host edge)
Requirement 10c: Outside repository control - Cloudflare challenge scripts (/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/*) loaded (injected by preview host edge)
Requirement 10d: Outside repository control - Cloudflare RUM beacons (POST /cdn-cgi/rum) sent with ZERO Referer headers (protected by Referrer-Policy)
Mobile viewport (390x844): All tests passed
Desktop viewport (1440x900): All tests passed

network_inspection.critical_finding: The Referrer-Policy: no-referrer header successfully prevents ALL attribution query parameters from appearing in Referer headers on application requests, development overlay requests, and preview host requests. The only Referer headers sent are from Google Fonts to Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com -> fonts.gstatic.com), which contain no attribution data.
